BubblesTheAnimator has his birthday in The Charcade, from theCharpy. I joined his birthday party.

Games in Order:
Skee Ball
Basketball
Stackers
Air Hockey
Dance Dance Revolution

After the games, I get a lot of prizes. Then we go to the tables. KayGames123 makes the cake, then we celebrate BubblesTheAnimator's birthday. Everyone has food! Then he opens the birthday gifts from everyone. Then theCharpy takes pictures of us. It was a fun day.

This took 1 week to make.
Time: 2 minutes and 57 seconds

This is my best animation. This has 454 assets, that is less than my basketball animation. It has 1,848 blocks of code. That is more code than my basketball animation. (Not including the loading animation)
